title: Injectivity of the bounded position code
statement: Let $B\in\bbn$, and let $z,z'\in\bbz$ satisfy $|z|\le B$ and $|z'|\le B$. If their position codes with bound $B$ are equal, then $z=z'$.
hypotheses_covered: The position codes of $z$ and $z'$ with bound $B$ are equal
